title: In Need of a New Hyperdrive
description: Escaping the Trade Federation, Queen Amidala's royal starship was damaged while escaping the planetary blockade. Unable to sustain its hyperdrive, the craft and all aboard landed on planet Tatooine for repairs. It was here that Amidala's Jedi protector Qui-Gon Jinn discovered a remarkable, Force-sensitive little boy named Anakin Skywalker, a child who would one day become one of the most significant heroes — and villains — of all time.
